---
name: bmad-prfaq
description: Draft a press-release and FAQ style product proposal for a proposed RAG feature. Use when asked to evaluate a feature from a user-outcome perspective.
---

# PR/FAQ

Write a future-facing summary of the user problem, proposed experience, benefits,
and important constraints, followed by FAQs about behavior, privacy, security,
availability, and limitations. Clearly label assumptions and unanswered
questions. Keep the proposal realistic for this MVP; do not imply unimplemented
features are already available.
